overviewHtml:
DQL queries consume budget, and it is rarely clear who runs the expensive ones. Governance and FinOps teams need visibility into usage and cost drivers across the environment.

What you get

  • Total DQL cost and cost over time
  • Data scanned in GB and execution counts
  • Heavy users, expensive queries, and costly data sources
  • Detection of inefficient or unoptimized DQL usage
setupHtml:
High‑level KPIs and trends including:

  • Total DQL cost
  • Cost over time
  • Data scanned (GB)
  • Execution counts
getStartedHtml:
1. Import the dashboard JSON into the Dashboards app
  2. Review the KPIs and trends for your timeframe
  3. Follow up with heavy users or costly queries
